description: MoroJS 1.8 on its native HTTP engine (@morojs/engine), clustered by the framework itself with one worker thread per core sharing the port through SO_REUSEPORT. Routing, path and query parameters and body parsing through the Moro request, JSON through res.json, compression (brotli quality 3 or gzip level 3 as the client accepts, one reused encoder per setting per worker, handed to the engine's own response path by the route middleware), static files from the built-in middleware's in-memory cache and the cache-aside through the built-in cache adapters, WebSockets through the engine's own RFC 6455 support, upgrades included, HTTP/2 through the engine's own implementation (ALPN h2 on TLS, prior knowledge on cleartext), TLS through the BoringSSL bundled with the engine, unparsed request bodies lent by the engine for the length of the request (server.lendBodies).
